trueReferenceNotes: Published reproduced true values use IAU1976/Wahr1980 at UT0. Nominal UTC midnight is used with explicit modern leap conversion; UT1/UTC differences are not a sub-milliarcsecond validation. Full original IAE rows and metadata remain a release gate. Inconsistent/typographic 2019/2020 mean rows were excluded rather than silently corrected.
